scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter "@fdrive/db..." run build && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.typecheck:tools: tsc -p tools/perf/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/office/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/deploy/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/dev/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:coverage: turbo run test:coverage && pnpm test:office:coverage && pnpm --filter @fdrive/web test:office:harness && pnpm test:perf:coverage && pnpm test:deploy:coverage && pnpm test:dev:tools
scripts.dev:env: tsx tools/dev/ensure-env.ts && docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.dev:env:reset: docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml down -v && tsx tools/dev/ensure-env.ts && docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.test:tools: vitest run --config tools/perf/vitest.config.ts && pnpm test:office:tools && pnpm test:deploy:tools && pnpm test:dev:tools
